theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_ims_imrep_tsum
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → ∑' i, (R i).measure U ≠ ∞ → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun i => (R i).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (R'.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
